  • Slavey↗Specific Dene language community connection
    Connection & source
    Specific Dene language community connection

    The territorial resource identifies South Slavey/Dene Zhatıé with a Fort Simpson edition and distinguishes North Slavey community editions. This supports a Northwest Territories language-community route for the broad outside label Slavey, without combining distinct Dene peoples into one nation. Inspection: Actual NWT resource introduction and labeled editions, lines 33–49. Linked books, language proficiency, current population and full homeland extent were not reviewed.

    Territorial education resource inspected October 21, 2026. Reviewed 2026-10-21.
